Description: Representation of a Synapse Access Requirement and its relationships to entities, grants, and projects.
DependsOn: AccessRequirement_id, contributorName, contributionDate, StudyKey, entityIdList, dataUseModifiers

Description: A unique identifier for the access requirement. This should be the numeric identifier of the access requirement.
The name of the person who added this access requirement.
The date on which the access requirement was added.
Synapse ID(s) for Synapse container(s) (e.g. Project, Dataset, Folder, Table, etc.) with which the Access Requirement is expected to be associated. Provide multiple values as a comma-separated list.
